mentions.name: VoltLaTeX
mentions.description: This project rewrites the LaTeX typesetting engine from scratch in Zig, byte compatible with pdfTeX, XeTeX, and LuaTeX, while compiling faster and providing better error messages for a modern developer experience.
mentions.problem: Existing LaTeX engines compile slowly and produce poor error messages.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am rewriting LaTeX from scratch in zig. Byte compatible with pdfTeX XeteX and luaTeX.

It’s faster at compiling, better errors with modern DX.
